list.subtitle: Which class, how many seats, and when guardians can apply online.
list.emptyText: Add a round so guardians can apply online.

form.dateRangeError: Close date must not be before open date.
form.datesHelp: Guardians can apply online between these two dates.
form.documentsHelp: Guardians must upload these when applying.

detail.closeConfirmBody: The public form stops taking applications for this round today. Applications already sent are kept.
detail.closeFailed: Could not close the round. Please try again.

help.title: The name guardians will recognise the round by, for example Class 6 Admission 2027.
help.classSection: The section to admit into. The student joins this section when admitted.
help.seatCount: How many can be admitted. Once that many are admitted, the round leaves the form. The number of applications does not block it.
help.closeDate: The last day to apply; the day itself counts. It cannot be before the open date.
help.requiredDocuments: Which of Photo, Birth certificate and Transcript the guardian must upload.
help.dates: The first and last day applications are open. Both days count; the close date cannot be before the open date.
